{"reason":"Add a high-confidence gate while preserving all existing criteria. V1 has recall 1.0 but a 0.714 false-arbitration rate (20/28) and fitness 0.286. Six of the eight cited false positives have confidence 0.44–0.67, so this edit should suppress them while retaining the 0.83 and 0.91 cases.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
